nodes.title: ADR 0032: Preserve explicit AppInstance branch selection
ADR 0046: Own production release deployment in Orbit

description:
The agent can inspect and replace the branch and ordered deployment steps for one production AppInstance without starting a deployment.

## Scope

* In: current AppInstance deployment configuration, strict Gateway requests, authorized responses, and configuration documentation.
* Out: deployment execution, App-level deployment templates, historical step snapshots, SDK, and CLI.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `GET /instances/{instance}/deployment-config` returns `branch` and ordered `steps`; `PUT` atomically replaces that complete configuration for an authorized production AppInstance, and rejects malformed, duplicate, unknown, or incorrectly typed input before saving. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/AppInstanceDeploymentConfigTest.php`.
- [ ] Each step has `name`, `phase` (`before_activation` or `after_activation`), `command`, and `timeout_seconds`; names are unique per instance and use the existing 1–63 character lowercase name rule, commands are nonempty UTF-8 of at most 16 KiB without NUL, and timeout is 1–900 seconds with default 300. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/DeploymentConfigTest.php`.
- [ ] At most 32 steps and at most 3,600 total configured timeout seconds are accepted; the array determines order within each phase, and an empty step list is valid. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/DeploymentConfigTest.php`.
- [ ] Branch input uses the existing Git branch validator; changing it preserves other AppInstances, never fetches code or changes `current`, and subsequent App default changes do not replace explicit deployment branch intent. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/DeploymentConfigTest.php`.
- [ ] An existing instance with no stored steps reads as an empty list and retains its configured branch; reads and writes use current Node-access authorization and keep commands out of Activity, validation errors, and generic diagnostics. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/AppInstanceDeploymentConfigTest.php`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes deployment configuration fields, limits, ordering, and explicit application-command ownership, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
title: Configure each production instance’s branch and deployment steps
